rationale: Ride-through compliance: The inverter remains connected throughout the event trace. During the voltage sag (t=0.05-0.55s), the voltage of 0.55 pu falls within the applicable ride-through envelope segment (min_voltage=0.5 pu for max_duration=0.7s), and the sag duration is well below the 0.7s threshold. Reactive current requirement: When voltage drops below 0.9 pu at t=0.05s, the reactive current requirement is triggered. By t=0.12s (7ms after onset, before the 0.1s deadline), reactive current reaches 0.25 pu, exceeding the minimum requirement of 0.2 pu. Both compliance clauses are satisfied.
